name: SANDJEST Nurse Nutrition Facts 40 oz Tumbler with Handle
seoTitle: Nurse Nutrition Facts Tumbler with Handle, 40 oz
metaDescription: A 40 oz insulated tumbler with a handle and a funny nurse nutrition facts label. A practical Nurses Week, birthday, or Christmas gift for a nursing friend.
summary: A big 40 oz insulated tumbler with a handle and a nurse themed nutrition facts label, a fun everyday gift for a nursing friend.
bestFor: Nurses who drink lots of water
whyItWorks: Most nurses know they should drink more water, and most also know how hard it is to grab a sip between call lights. A 40 oz tumbler holds enough to cover a big chunk of a shift, so there are fewer trips to the fountain. The handle makes it easy to carry from the parking lot to the locker room with a badge, a lunch bag, and a phone already in hand. Insulated stainless steel helps ice last longer during the stretch to lunch.

The nutrition facts design is the fun part. It borrows the food label format to list the things nurses run on, which tends to get a laugh at the nurses station. It is a natural pick for Nurses Week, a birthday, or a Christmas exchange among friends from nursing school. Check that the wording matches her sense of humor, and consider adding a pack of drink mix to make the gift feel complete.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to see the lid style and if a straw is included, since the title mentions a handle only.
A 40 oz tumbler is large, so confirm it fits her car cup holder if that matters.
Read the full nutrition facts text in the photos to be sure it suits her humor.

faq.q: Will a 40 oz tumbler fit in a car cup holder?
faq.a: Many large tumblers have a narrower base for cup holders, but check the listing dimensions to be sure.

faq.q: Is this a good Nurses Week gift?
faq.a: Yes, it is practical, fun, and big enough to feel like a real gift. It works well from a manager, a friend, or a family member.
